notes: SAC completed recapture of Maw Taung — KNLA Brigade 4's strategic Thailand border crossing — on May 19, 2026 after two-week three-column offensive (launched ~May 5); KNLA had held Maw Taung since November 2025 (6 months); thousands displaced toward Ranong, Thailand; critical resistance logistics link to Thailand lost; DVB/Mizzima/Moemaka confirmed

label: SAC Jets + Navy: Naypyidaw → Sanae, Kyaukphyu District (Rakhine State)
casualties: Multiple civilians killed; 50,000+ displaced from 10+ villages
damage: 100+ homes destroyed in Shwe Hintha Ward, Sanae town; naval shelling causes civilian casualties
notes: SAC jets and warships struck Sanae Township, Kyaukphyu District on May 21, 2026 as AA advances on Chinese CMEC port; 100+ homes destroyed in Shwe Hintha Ward; junta previously repelled AA-repulsed amphibious assault from Taungmawgyi naval base on May 10; Irrawaddy / BNI Online / CDM confirmed

label: SAC Jet/Gyrocopter: Naypyidaw → Mae Baw Khee Village (Hpa-an Township, Karen State)
casualties: 1 killed (19-year-old woman); 5 injured including 2 children
notes: SAC fighter jet and/or gyrocopter attack on Mae Baw Khee village in Hpa-an Township, Karen State on May 19, 2026; killed 19-year-old displaced woman; part of SAC multi-location aerial campaign on same day as Maw Taung and Tonzang recaptures; CDM confirmed

label: PDF: Sagaing Area → Saing Pyin Police Station (Depayin Township) Capture
casualties: 11 junta security personnel killed; weapons and ammunition seized
notes: PDF forces captured Saing Pyin police station in Depayin Township, Sagaing Region; operation launched May 14, station fully seized May 16; local police chief abandoned injured personnel; reported in CDM May 20 bulletin; Depayin includes Kanbalu area (site of 2022 concert massacre); continued PDF targeting of junta security infrastructure in Sagaing heartland

label: SAC 300-Vehicle Convoy: Mandalay → Myitkyina Northern Command (Kachin Reinforcement)
notes: Approximately 300-vehicle SAC convoy with mobile howitzers, armor, and support vehicles departed Mandalay ~May 9 and reached Northern Military Command HQ in Myitkyina by May 22; largest junta reinforcement to Kachin State in years; directly prompted KIA to announce shift to defensive strategy; SAC aims to relieve Myitkyina garrison (encircled by KIA) and sever KIA's operational corridor to northern Sagaing Region; part of coordinated May 2026 multi-front offensive surge

label: PDF/Resistance: Sagaing → NW Regional Command HQ Monywa (Rocket Attack)
casualties: 8 junta personnel killed; 20+ injured
notes: PDF and allied resistance rocket attack on SAC Northwest Regional Military Command HQ in Monywa; confirmed by NUG Deputy Minister of Home Affairs and Immigration; one of the most significant strikes on a junta regional command HQ since the coup; NW Command oversees SAC operations across Sagaing and Mandalay regions; attack exploited operational overextension from junta's simultaneous multi-front offensive surge

label: SAC Airstrike: Mandalay → Indaw Township, Mawluu Area (Sagaing)
casualties: 5 PDF fighters killed; 2 civilians injured
notes: SAC airstrike struck Hman Hae Village in PDF-controlled Mawluu area, Indaw Township, Sagaing Region on May 25, 2026; 5 resistance members killed and 2 civilians injured; part of SAC ongoing effort to clear PDF fighters from the Indaw-Katha corridor following junta recapture of the Mandalay-Myitkyina highway (Mawlu, May 5); Myanmar Now / LiveUAMap CDM reporting

label: PDF/Anyar Myay: Sagaing Corridor → Myaing Township (Militia Base Captured)
casualties: 49 civilians rescued; weapons and ammunition confiscated
notes: PDF and Anyar Myay Coalition Force seized Pyu Saw Htee militia camp at Thayetkan Village, Myaing Township, Magway Region on May 26; 49 civilians (women and children) held under militia control were rescued; follow-on mine attacks May 27 killed 2 more junta soldiers; Myanmar Now / Mizzima confirmed

label: KIA FPV Drone: Myitkyina Area → Bhamo Township (5 Junta Killed)
casualties: 5 junta soldiers killed
notes: KIA-aligned resistance FPV (first-person view) drone strike on junta army formations in Bhamo Township, Kachin State on May 26, 2026; demonstrates continued localized offensive operations despite KIA's May 22 announced defensive strategy shift; Bhamo-Waingmaw district is active KIA frontline with IB-58 encircled to within 100m; Mizzima Spring Revolution Daily confirmed

label: SAC Airstrike: Naypyidaw → Kyain Seikkyi Township (Karen State)
casualties: 3 women killed; no preceding ground engagement
notes: SAC fighter jet bombed Kyain Seikkyi Township, Karen State on May 27, 2026 killing 3 women with no preceding battle; KNU Central confirmed; Kawkareik District approach corridor toward Myawaddy; part of sustained SAC aerial campaign across KNLA-controlled Karen State; Mizzima Spring Revolution Daily confirmed

label: SAC Drone: Naypyidaw → Ngazun Township (9 Killed, Mandalay)
casualties: 9 civilians killed including woman shielding infant
notes: SAC armed drone strike on Ngazun Township, Mandalay Region after brief resistance clash; mother killed shielding infant — collective punishment; part of sustained SAC drone campaign across Myingyan District; Myanmar Now confirmed

label: SAC Jet + Drones: Mandalay Area → Khin-U Township, Sagaing (4 Killed)
casualties: 4 civilians killed; 20+ homes destroyed
damage: Ywa Sin village bombed; residential area destroyed
notes: Junta fighter jet from Tada-U Air Base bombed Ywa Sin village, Khin-U Township at ~9:00 pm; two SAC suicide drones struck 40 minutes later; no fighting had been reported in township at time of attack; 4 civilians killed (man 45, man 20, woman 62, woman 27); Mizzima confirmed via local sources

label: AA: Northern Rakhine → Kyaukphyu Encirclement (5km)
notes: AA advances to within ~5km of Kyaukphyu (China's $7.3B CMEC deep-sea port) by early June 2026; junta warships from Danyawaddy naval base shelling area as all land supply routes are cut; AA simultaneously maintaining Sittwe and Ngape fronts; Irrawaddy confirmed

label: SAC Mass Airstrikes: Naypyidaw → Bhamo (50/day — KIA Siege Defense)
notes: SAC conducting up to 50 airstrikes per day on KIA siege positions around Bhamo city as of June 2026; highest air power concentration in Kachin State since the coup; KIA-led coalition maintains encirclement despite 300-vehicle SAC reinforcement convoy that arrived at Northern Command Myitkyina May 22; if Bhamo falls, KIA controls all eastern Kachin State; Irrawaddy / CSIS confirmed

label: AA: Maungdaw Corridor → Sittwe Naval Complex (40+ Junta Killed May 29–Jun 1)
casualties: 40+ junta soldiers killed including a captain; heavy artillery exchanges in Bay of Bengal and Kaladan River
notes: Fierce AA assault on Shwe Min Gan naval support base and Kyar Ma Thauk village military position May 29–June 1, 2026; 40+ regime soldiers killed in engagements ~2 km from naval base; heavy artillery exchanges between AA forces and junta naval vessels from Danyawaddy base; junta 'firing nonstop' per Irrawaddy; Sittwe residents report junta fortifying river routes with bunkers and landmines; AA vowed to capture all remaining Rakhine towns (Sittwe, Kyaukphyu, Manaung) by 2027; Irrawaddy confirmed

label: KIA-PDF: Bhamo / Kachin → Indaw Corridor (Guerrilla Ambushes Continue)
casualties: 13 SAC soldiers killed in Katha-Nabar road ambush (May 24); ongoing attrition through May 28
notes: KIA and allied PDF forces continue guerrilla ambushes along Mandalay-Myitkyina road corridor and Sagaing-Kachin border through May 28, 2026, contesting junta's nominal highway control following SAC's May 5 recapture of Mawlu; KIA encirclement of IB-58 in Waingmaw maintained to within 100m; 300-vehicle SAC convoy reached Myitkyina Northern Command by May 22 — largest Kachin reinforcement in years; Myanmar Now / MoeMaKa confirmed ongoing heavy clashes

label: SAC Double Airstrike: Naypyidaw → Kanbalu Township, Sagaing — 133+ Civilians Killed
casualties: 133+ civilians killed; double strike (morning + 17:30); women and children among dead; rescuers targeted in second wave
notes: SAC jets struck Kanbalu Township twice on June 3, 2026 — morning strike then returned at 17:30 to target rescuers; double-tap tactic; one of deadliest single-day attacks in Sagaing Region since coup; Rising Nepal Daily / Irrawaddy confirmed

label: KIA: Myitkyina Area → Bhamo (Tank Battalion Seized + Airport Camps Captured)
casualties: Junta tank battalion seized; multiple SAC frontline camps near airport captured; radar system at Myitkyina Air Base destroyed
notes: KIA seized junta tank battalion near Bhamo airport and destroyed radar at Myitkyina Air Base in early June 2026; KIA holds all positions despite 50 SAC airstrikes/day; Col. Naw Bu confirmed airport camp captures; Myanmar Now / Irrawaddy confirmed

label: AA: Rakhine → Mindon Township (1,000-Man SAC Column Intercepted)
casualties: 400+ junta troops claimed killed; ~100 surrendered (resistance claims, unverified)
notes: AA and allied forces intercepted ~1,000-man SAC column in Mindon Township, Magway Region (May 30–June 2); resistance scattered column in mountains; AA expanding operational reach to interdict SAC Rakhine supply routes; high casualty claims from single resistance source — treat with caution

label: KNLA Br. 2 / Brave Warriors: Karen Hills → Toungoo Air Base (Rocket Attack)
notes: Brave Warriors for Myanmar and KNLA Brigade 2, Battalion 5 fired 4x107mm rockets at Toungoo Air Base (Kaytumadi) and Kaytumadi Hotel on June 6; attack reportedly timed to Min Aung Hlaing secret visit to area; casualties unconfirmed; MoeMaKa CDM confirmed

label: SAC Jets (Tada-U): Mandalay → Malaiing Township (Thayet Kaung Pin Village, 2 Killed)
casualties: 2 civilians killed; 4 children seriously injured; 6 houses destroyed
damage: Thayet Kaung Pin village bombed; 6 houses destroyed; no active fighting in area at time of strike
notes: Two SAC Yak-130 jets from Tada-U air base dropped 4 bombs on Thayet Kaung Pin village, Malaiing Township, Mandalay Region on June 5, 2026; no active fighting reported in township; MoeMaKa CDM confirmed in June 7 bulletin

label: SAC Drones + Artillery: Naypyidaw → Demoso/Hpruso/Nanmekhon (Karenni State)
casualties: 1 Baptist pastor killed; 3+ civilians injured
notes: SAC deployed aircraft, suicide drones, and artillery against Demoso, Hpruso, and Nanmekhon areas, Karenni State on June 6–7; Baptist pastor killed — latest in series of clergy killed in SAC air attacks in 2026; KNDF and KA still control most of Karenni State rural territory; MoeMaKa CDM confirmed

label: AA: Repels Junta Offensive Near Kyaukphyu Naval Station
casualties: Junta column routed; bodies, weapons, ammunition abandoned
notes: Junta surprise monsoon offensive near Awataung Village repelled by AA forces; column retreated toward Taungmaw Naval Station

label: SAC Aircraft: Naypyidaw → Loikaw IDP Camps
casualties: 1 displaced woman killed by shrapnel
damage: Multiple houses and vehicles destroyed across two IDP camps and one village
notes: Three junta aircraft dropped 14 bombs across two IDP camps and a village in eastern Loikaw with no prior clashes reported — direct targeting of civilian/IDP sites

label: Resistance: Myawaddy → Kawkareik Convoy Ambush
casualties: 15+ soldiers killed, 20+ injured
notes: Resistance forces ambushed an 8-truck junta reinforcement convoy on the Myawaddy-Kawkareik section of the Asian Highway; one vehicle overturned

label: SAC Fighter Jet: Thandwe → Ma-Ei Town (Toungup)
casualties: 5 killed, 14 injured
damage: 10+ houses damaged in Wards 2 and 3
notes: Junta fighter jet dropped three 500-pound bombs on Ma-Ei town, Toungup Township; a Buddhist monk was among the wounded

label: DPLA: Ambush on Ywangan-Yatsauk Road
casualties: 40+ junta soldiers killed
notes: Danu People's Liberation Army ambushed a military convoy, seizing weapons and ammunition; junta retaliated with 1,000+ troop deployment into Ywangan Township

label: SAC 'Area Clearance': Dawei → Yebyu Township
casualties: 6 civilians killed (incl. a monk and a minor), 13 arrested

notes: Deputy C-in-C Kyaw Swar Lin ordered clearance operations with ~1,000 troops to secure the stalled Dawei Special Economic Zone, beginning July 9, 2026

label: SAC Air Campaign: Arakan Mountain Range (Nat Yay Kan / Goteseeyoe)
damage: Junta pushes to recapture Chinese gas-pipeline route territory from AA

label: SAC Drone: Loikaw → Hpruso Township
casualties: 5 killed (incl. a 5-month-old infant), 1 wounded (prior day)
notes: Junta drone dropped two heavy bombs on a residential area in western Hpruso Township; a drone had wounded a woman in eastern Hpruso the previous day

label: SAC Aircraft: Naypyidaw → Demawso Middle School
casualties: 1 displaced man killed, 1 woman wounded
damage: Middle-school building hit just after dismissal; 5+ schools closed indefinitely
notes: Aircraft bombed a middle school in western Demawso; artillery shells also landed near an IDP camp per the Interim Executive Council

label: SAC Jet (Tada-U): → Kan Phyu Village, Wetlet Township
damage: 2 school buildings and ~3 homes damaged; 13 cattle killed
notes: Bomb dropped near the Abhidhamma school in Kan Phyu village; part of a broader pattern of drone/air attacks on Yoar Thar Yar tract villages

label: KIA/KPDF: Recapture Lonton Camp (Indawgyi)
casualties: 6 SNA militia bodies recovered; heavy junta/SNA casualties
notes: KIA and Kachin People's Defence Force jointly recaptured Lonton camp near Indawgyi, Mohnyin Township, lost to junta/SNA forces in June

label: KIA Drone/Artillery: Danai Militia Base
casualties: 5 militia killed, 10 injured

label: SAC Jet: → Kyauk Gyi Village, Thandwe Township
casualties: 14 killed (11 female, 3 male, ages 9-88), 11 injured
damage: ~20 houses and buildings damaged near Dhamma Yaung Chi monastery
notes: Fighter jet circled the AA-controlled village for ~20 minutes before dropping 3 high-explosive bombs; part of a wider week-long air campaign across Kyauktaw, Mrauk-U, Thandwe, Gwa, Kyeintali and Virathani townships

label: SAC Jet: → Paletwa Town Entrance

label: SAC Aircraft: Naypyidaw → Ngapali (Thandwe)
casualties: 1 killed, 14 injured (AA claim)
notes: AA reported 8 jets plus a Y-12 and Y-8 dropped ~100 bombs across Ngapali and Nyaung Chaung (Gwa) overnight; single-source AA claim, not independently corroborated for this specific night.

label: SAC Aircraft: Naypyidaw → Nyaung Chaung Village (Gwa)
casualties: 8 injured (AA claim)

notes: ACLED-estimated ~700-troop column burning villages and clearing land since July for the Russia-backed Dawei port SEZ; 3 aid workers killed Jul 9; offensive continues toward Hteekhee.

casualties: School building destroyed
